meta.title: Toolbox Enhanced
meta.description: Companion to dsh-toolbox-ui 1.12.0 or 1.12.1. Adds the native shell, upper sidebar entry, startup timeout export and local tool policy. Edits involving startupTimeoutMs are rejected before writing; use DSH native configuration editing for those connections. Other management and update checks remain upstream-owned. Disabling this companion restores the original interface.
